I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

- **Source:** Dana's own posts in #north-team on 2025-08-20. She first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later ("It's 185, not 180"). She's a member of that channel, so she could see this herself.
- **Not checked against the contract:** none of the Quarrendon account files show up in the share from Dana's view, so I couldn't open the signed amendment. I pointed her to June Osei-Lark, who has the signed copy, in case she wants to double-check before the QBR.
- **Rules:** a seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, and Dana is on the account's team, so no approval was needed. I left out any pricing.
- **Similar name:** the share also has a note on "Quarendon Freightways." That's a different company, not a Pemberline customer, so I didn't use it.
